content.text: All rules searched. Submitting the plan.

parties.counterparty: Marshall & Ilsley Corporation, acting through its M&I Data Services division ("M&I")

input.plans: [{"ruleId":"LOL-CAP","candidateSectionIds":["sec-13","sec-11","sec-22"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0198","p0199","p0200","p0201","p0202","p0203","p0204","p0205","p0206","p0207","p0187","p0189","p0304"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Cap sits at § 13.4 (p0207): M&I liability capped at fees paid in the 3 months prior to the event, plus a 1-year suit limitation (carve-out only for collection of amounts due). Mutual consequential waiver at § 13.2 (p0205); helpful enumerated direct damages at § 13.1 (p0198-p0204); equitable relief preserved (p0206). Assess against playbook: the cap is one-sided in effect (M&I-only cap while Customer's termination fees are expressly excluded from § 13.4 — see p0187, p0189), 3 months is very low, and there are no carve-outs for indemnity, confidentiality/data breach, or willful misconduct. Note p0304 (negotiated-limitations construction clause) as context. Do not double-flag the termination-fee amount here — that belongs to T4C/LD."},{"ruleId":"INDEMN","candidateSectionIds":["sec-14","sec-6.4","sec-21.4"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0220","p0219","p0221","p0222","p0223","p0224","p0225","p0114","p0117","p0270","p0279"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Vendor indemnity present at § 14.2(B) (p0220) covering third-party IP infringement (US patent/copyright/trademark), third-party claims re M&I systems, breach of its reps, discrimination/harassment, injury/death, and property/financial loss from M&I acts or omissions — meets the preferred position. Customer's reverse indemnity at § 14.2(A) (p0219) is a mirror but note the § 6.6(B) hook and the Customer-pays-enforcement-costs sentence. Procedures at § 14.3 (p0221-p0225). Additional Customer-side indemnities to check for breadth: § 6.5 ACH mutual indemnity (p0114) with M&I's ACH liability narrowed to gross negligence/willful misconduct (p0117), § 21.4 reliance-on-data indemnity (p0270), and § 21.9 TIN hold-harmless (p0279)."},{"ruleId":"NONCOMPETE","candidateSectionIds":["sec-21.4","sec-23","sec-10"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0273","p0313","p0183"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"No non-compete on Customer's line of business. Closest restrictions are use/field-of-use limits: § 21.7(B) (p0273) confines Customer to internal business purposes and bars reselling Services to third parties; § 23.5 (p0313) restricts source-code use to internal processing and existing functionalities. These are conventional resale/scope limits rather than restraints on the businesses we operate, so likely compliant; § 10.3(A) (p0183) is a purchase restriction handled under EXCLUSIVITY/MINCOMMIT, not here."},{"ruleId":"EXCLUSIVITY","candidateSectionIds":["sec-10","sec-3","sec-21.4"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0183","p0280","p0057","p0058"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Responsive: § 10.3(A) (p0183) requires Customer, during the entire 8-year Term, to obtain from M&I all Services included in the Monthly Base Fee (Schedule 6.2) — a sole-source lock with no partial-termination or exit mechanism, and it removes our freedom to buy elsewhere. Reinforced by § 21.10 (p0280), which sweeps all Affiliate/subsidiary processing into the Agreement. Note § 3.1/3.2 (p0057-p0058) permit M&I to subcontract to Affiliates/third parties while we are locked in — asymmetry worth citing."},{"ruleId":"MFN","candidateSectionIds":[],"candidateParagraphIds":[],"likelyAbsent":true,"note":"No MFN or most-favoured-pricing language anywhere; repeated searches (most favored/favoured, no less favorable, comparable customers, lowest price, best pricing) returned nothing. Pricing is fixed by the Fee Schedule with discounts at p0153 and M&I's then-current published prices in places (p0151, p0192). No MFN burden on us, so nothing to flag; an MFN in our favour is a nice-to-have ask only."},{"ruleId":"NOSOLICIT","candidateSectionIds":["sec-22"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0302","p0010"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"§ 22.14 (p0302): mutual, Term-limited ('during the Term ... for any reason') bar on soliciting the other party's employees. Mutuality and time limit are acceptable, but there is no general-advertising / unsolicited-applicant / non-targeted-recruitment carve-out and 'employees' is unqualified — measure against the playbook's narrow-carve-out requirement and note the missing advertising carve-out."},{"ruleId":"T4C","candidateSectionIds":["sec-11","sec-13","sec-20","sec-10","sec-1"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0187","p0189","p0190","p0208","p0263","p0180","p0181","p0039","p0038"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Customer T4C exists at § 11.1 (p0187) but is heavily penalised: one (1) year's notice plus a Termination for Convenience Fee of a REDACTED percentage of Estimated Remaining Value (defined p0039), plus unamortised Conversion costs and disposition Expenses, 50% payable on notice, and expressly outside the § 13.4 cap. § 11.2(A) (p0189) imposes a Termination for Cause Fee even where Customer terminates under 11.1 without the notice formalities. Favourable offsets to preserve: p0190 (no fee if we terminate for M&I default) and p0263 (termination without penalty for unresolved Disaster). Also note M&I's unilateral partial withdrawal right on 90 days at § 10.2 (p0180-p0181) — vendor-side exit mid-term."},{"ruleId":"RENEWAL","candidateSectionIds":["sec-2","sec-1"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0054","p0055","p0049"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"No auto-renewal: § 2.1 (p0054) plus § 2.2 (p0055) require M&I to submit a renewal proposal 18 months before expiry, Customer responds within 6 months, and if no agreement Customer holds a unilateral option to extend 12 months at then-current terms on 5 months' notice. Term is 8 years from the Commencement Date (p0049). The mechanic is Customer-favourable (option, not auto-renew) — do not flag; note only the long 8-year initial term and the burdensome notice choreography in the rationale."},{"ruleId":"GOVLAW","candidateSectionIds":["sec-22","sec-15","sec-p0007"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0286","p0287","p0298","p0299","p0226","p0227","p0228"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"§ 22.1 (p0286) selects Wisconsin internal law; § 22.2 (p0287) fixes exclusive venue in Milwaukee County and the E.D. Wis. — courts, not foreign arbitration, but Wisconsin is outside the accepted list (NY/DE/CA/E&W). Note § 22.10/22.11 (p0298, p0299) reference an 'arbitrator' and § 15 (p0226-p0228) is an escalation/continuity-of-performance process; check whether any binding arbitration is imported. Home-forum-for-vendor point is the substance to raise."},{"ruleId":"ASSIGN","candidateSectionIds":["sec-22","sec-21.4","sec-11"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0289","p0281","p0282","p0284","p0031","p0191"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"§ 22.4 (p0289): consent required both ways (not unreasonably withheld); Customer gets a merger exception only if the survivor becomes an affiliate of a $100MM+ financial institution and § 21.11 is complied with, while M&I may assign freely on merger/sale of assets or to a successor of the M&I Data Services division — clearly asymmetric, and no affiliate-assignment right for us. On change of control, § 21.11(B) (p0284) caps M&I's post-CoC obligation to the pre-CoC entities and to prior 3-month volumes +25%; § 21.11(A) (p0282-p0283) puts all new-Affiliate Conversion Expenses and to-be-agreed Conversion Fees on us. 'Control' defined at p0031. Also confirm redacted § 11.3 (p0191, 'Following Change in Control of Customer' per the TOC) — it may add a termination fee on our CoC; flag as unreviewable/redacted."},{"ruleId":"IP","candidateSectionIds":["sec-17","sec-p0184","sec-23"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0243","p0244","p0245","p0248","p0249","p0250","p0185","p0313"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Customer Data ownership is protected: § 17.1 (p0243) makes Customer sole and exclusive owner of all Customer Data and Confidential Information; confidentiality and security obligations at p0245-p0250. Deviation risk is deliverables: § 10.4 (p0185) gives M&I ownership of all programs and of any work of authorship created in performing the Services 'even if paid for by Customer' (Developed Software), with only a partial refund/credit mechanic and a right for M&I to resell to other customers; § 17.2 (p0244) says Customer has no rights in M&I software beyond Term-limited use. Position: we should own or at minimum hold a perpetual paid-up licence in custom work we fund."},{"ruleId":"LICENSE","candidateSectionIds":["sec-23","sec-17","sec-21.4"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0310","p0311","p0312","p0313","p0306","p0307","p0244","p0280"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Only licence grant is the escrow source-code licence at § 23.4 (p0310): non-exclusive, non-transferable, limited to the end of the Term, conditioned on paying then-current licence fees and on release events (p0311-p0312), with use restrictions at § 23.5 (p0313) — no distribution/sublicensing, so no express contractor or affiliate/designee coverage (though p0313 refers to 'or its designee'). § 17.2 (p0244) frames Customer's rights in M&I software as Term-only use with no other rights. Affiliate use is addressed indirectly at § 21.10 (p0280). Test against the rule: term-limited, fee-conditioned, non-transferable and silent on contractors; also flag that release is triggered only by cessation/insolvency, not by material breach."},{"ruleId":"AUDIT","candidateSectionIds":["sec-21.4","sec-17"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0273","p0274","p0275","p0276","p0277","p0243"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"No vendor audit of our usage or records for licence-compliance purposes, so the rule's core risk is absent. Related provisions run the other way and are largely favourable: § 21.8(C) (p0277) gives us a free copy of M&I's annual third-party data-centre review with implementation of recommendations; § 21.8(B) (p0276) preserves regulator examination; § 17.1 (p0243) preserves auditor/regulator access. Two Customer-burden points to note, not necessarily flag: § 21.8 (p0274) requires us to reimburse M&I's costs of regulatory examinations relating to our Services, and § 21.7(C)(ii) (p0273) requires us to evidence our books-and-records treatment on M&I's request."},{"ruleId":"LD","candidateSectionIds":["sec-13","sec-11","sec-1","sec-9","sec-8.13"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0208","p0187","p0189","p0039","p0177","p0149","p0151"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Direction is against us: § 13.5 (p0208) has Customer acknowledge the Termination for Convenience Fee and Termination for Cause Fee are liquidated damages and not a penalty, and both are carved out of the § 13.4 cap (p0187, p0189, formula at p0039). Service credits running to us exist only as § 9.2(D) 'Service Level Credits — REDACTED' (p0177), so the reciprocal benefit is unverifiable — note the redaction. Also note collection fees/Damages and default repricing to standard published prices (p0149, p0151). Coordinate with T4C so the fee quantum is argued once."},{"ruleId":"WARRANTY","candidateSectionIds":["sec-16.1","sec-9","sec-12","sec-16.2"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0231","p0232","p0233","p0234","p0235","p0236","p0155","p0156","p0177","p0194","p0237"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"§ 16.1 (p0231-p0235) gives Term-long capability, User Manual conformity, rights/authority and Millennium Compliance warranties at no charge, supported by the § 9 Performance Standards (p0155-p0177) and an M&I Event of Default for failure to meet a Performance Standard (p0194). Weaknesses to weigh: § 16.1(F) (p0236) is a full disclaimer of merchantability/fitness and all other warranties; § 9.1 (p0155) sets 'commercially reasonable manner and no other or higher degree of care'; the cure period for missing a Performance Standard is 90 days (p0194) and the credits remedy is redacted (p0177). Customer reps at § 16.2 (p0237 et seq.) for symmetry."},{"ruleId":"INSURANCE","candidateSectionIds":["sec-14"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0211","p0212","p0213","p0214","p0215","p0216","p0217"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Present and reasonably robust: § 14.1(A) requires M&I to maintain, at its own cost throughout the Term, CGL of $2,000,000 (p0212-p0213), Fidelity/employee-dishonesty of $10,000,000 covering all aspects of the Services (p0214), Workers' Comp with $500,000 Employer's Liability (p0215) and All Risk Property (p0216); § 14.1(B) (p0217) requires A-rated carriers, 30 days' notice of material change or cancellation, and certificates at execution and annually on request. Gaps to note rather than flag: no professional liability/E&O and no cyber/privacy cover for a data-processing outsourcer."},{"ruleId":"MINCOMMIT","candidateSectionIds":["sec-8","sec-8.13","sec-10","sec-1","sec-8.7"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0130","p0149","p0183","p0039","p0141","p0142","p0146"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"Take-or-pay structure: § 8.1(ii) (p0130) sets a minimum Monthly Base Fee for bundled Services with uplifts as volumes rise; § 8.13 (p0149) makes all minimum monthly fees payable in advance by ACH debit; § 10.3(A) (p0183) forces us to keep buying every Service in the Monthly Base Fee for the whole 8-year Term with no descope right; and the minimum feeds the Estimated Remaining Value termination-fee formula (p0039), so the only exit is the T4C fee. Note also no-discount and excluded-cost provisions (p0141, p0142, p0146). Exit mechanism is the material gap."},{"ruleId":"TRANSITION","candidateSectionIds":["sec-p0191","sec-1","sec-17","sec-23"],"candidateParagraphIds":["p0192","p0038","p0243","p0250","p0310","p0313"],"likelyAbsent":false,"note":"§ 11.4 (p0192) is a real Termination Assistance clause: triggered 6 months pre-expiry or on any termination for any reason, all necessary assistance to avoid interruption, transition planning on a Customer-developed schedule, continued Services at contract rates for up to 6 months on 100 days' notice, good-faith cost estimate in advance, and no obligation on us to take it. Deviations to weigh: everything is at Customer's expense at M&I's then-current rates, the continuation election needs 100 days' notice (and the extension is capped at 6 months), and there is no express obligation to return or delete Customer Data in a usable format on exit — ownership at § 17.1 (p0243) and security at § 17.5 (p0250) do not supply a return/deletion mechanic. Source-code fallback at §§ 23.4-23.5 (p0310, p0313) ends with the Term. 'Effective Date of Termination' defined p0038."}]}
